View less classifications",SICHUAN AGRICULTURAL UNIVERSITY四川农业大学,LIANG YUEYANG梁越洋ZHOU DAN周丹YANG NA杨娜LI PING李平LI SHUANGCHENG李双成KIM KYOUNG HWA金京花ZOU TING邹挺WANG SHIQUAN王世全DENG QIMING邓其明ZHU JUN朱军,北京之于行知识产权代理有限公司 11767,(EN) Rice SDT6 gene as well as encoding protein and application thereof(ZH) 水稻SDT6基因、其编码蛋白及其应用,,"(EN) The invention relates to a rice SDT6 gene as well as an encoding protein and application thereof. The invention provides an SDT6 gene for regulating and controlling a rice plant type. A nucleotide sequence of the SDT6 gene is as shown in SEQ ID NO.2 or SEQ ID NO.3. The invention further provides a preparation method of the SDT6 gene. The amino acid sequence of the protein coded by the SDT6 gene is as shown in SEQ ID NO. 1. A semi-dwarf mutant with increased tillering is screened, a target gene for regulating the phenotype is successfully cloned, after the gene is knocked out in a japonica rice ZH11 material through a CRISPR/Cas9 technology, the rice plant height is obviously reduced, the tillering is obviously increased, the gene function is further verified through gene function complementation verification, and the application of the gene in the field of rice production is promoted. It is preliminarily verified that the gene SDT6 regulates the plant height and tillering of rice, and it is found that the gene SDT6 is related to an auxin regulation mechanism in rice. The application has important significance in breeding rice, indica rice or japonica rice with excellent yield and/or lodging resistance.(ZH) 本发明涉及水稻SDT6基因、其编码蛋白及其应用。本发明提供一种调控水稻株型的SDT6基因，SDT6基因的核苷酸序列如SEQ ID NO.2或SEQ ID NO.3所示。SDT6基因编码的蛋白质的氨基酸序列如SEQ ID NO.1所示。本发明筛选到半矮杆、分蘖增加的突变体并成功克隆调控该表型的目的基因，通过CRISPR/Cas9技术在粳稻ZH11材料中将该基因敲除后，水稻株高明显降低且分蘖显著增加，利用基因功能互补验证进一步证实了该基因功能，初步验证了基因SDT6调控水稻的株高及分蘖，并发现其与水稻体内生长素调节机制相关。本申请在选育具有优良产量和/或抗倒伏性能的水稻、籼或粳稻方面具有重要意义。",2024102144167 26.02.2024 CN,,,,,,,,,

View less classifications","Guangdong Sanjie Forage Biotechnology Co., Ltd","CHEN, HaitaoHE, HuiQIU, QiangSHANG, ZhanhuanSU, KexianWANG, WenXIE, Xiongping",Davies Collison Cave Pty Ltd,(EN) Method for site-specific mutagenesis of medicago sativa gene by using CRISPR/Cas9 system,,"(EN) A method for site-specific mutagenesis of a medicago sativa gene by using a CRISPR/Cas9 system. The method comprises: first constructing a universal binary expression vector MsCRISPR/Cas9 mediated and transformed by agrobacterium tumefaciens in medicago sativa; then designing a CRISPR/Cas9-based sgRNA sequence for a target gene in the medicago sativa, and connecting a DNA fragment for encoding the sgRNA sequence to MsCRISPR/Cas9 to construct a carrier MsCRISPR/Cas9::target; and then mediating and transforming the medicago sativa by using the agrobacterium tumefaciens, and obtaining, by screening, a mutant transformed plant with the target gene knocked out.
